- When sentiment is negative (especially > -0.5) and forecast is rising, reduce forecast by 1-2% to avoid overcorrection.  
- When sentiment is positive (especially > 0.3) and forecast is falling, increase forecast by 1-2% to avoid underestimating rebound.  
- Avoid forecasting sharp upward spikes after recent lows — model tends to overshoot; cap peak forecasts at 1.5x recent high.  
- Mean-reversion bias: if forecast is > 1.2x recent 7-day average, reduce by 10-15% unless sentiment strongly bullish.  
- Lagged bias: if true outcome is > 1.1x forecast at day 10+ of horizon, adjust future days downward by 0.5-1.0% per day.  
- Horizon-specific: for 30-day forecasts, if sentiment is neutral or negative, reduce forecast by 0.5-1.5% per day from day 15 onward.
